why_this_rate: The rate the other whole-type models of this unit are drawn at. The canceller's delay is fitted in whole samples of it, and the interaural delays are fractions of a sample read by linear interpolation.
what_varies: One source, the two inputs summed; per ear a spherical head's delay and shadow and nothing else, so the head is front-back symmetric and behind renders as the front does, and the speaker rendering takes from each output a filtered, delayed copy of the other, the inverse of a symmetric crosstalk path, which moves the median plane as well. Fitted on the azimuth sweep's takes against the bypassed takes beside them: 2.86 dB rms over the phones bands and 5.48 dB over the speaker bands.
